literal_meaning: টেঁদো বা বাঁকা (onomatopoeic for sly or wriggling movement)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা তেঁদড় ছেলে, সবসময় দুষ্টুমি করে।
example_sentences_in_english: That guy is such a rascal.
He is a naughty boy who always gets into mischief.
note: Dialectal variation common in rural Bengali speech
